Senses.PreferredTarget: the sun's disk exactly at noon
AlternateTargets: the sun directly overhead at midday
Senses.Note: Four distinct deployments in four independent works anchor direct answers and verse comment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂。僧問：「古剎重開，人天際會，學人上來，請師一接。」師云：「日輪正當午。」進云：「恁麼則函蓋乾坤，掀翻大地去也。」師云：「猶涉功勳在。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB300.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chaozong. Chaozong Tongren answers a request for reception with the noon-sun line, then says the monk's elaboration still involves achievement.

Occurrences.Kwic: 五月二十日早，師謂眾曰：「今日不得離我這裏。」曇瑞問：「如何是今日事？」師曰：「日輪正當午。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB425.xml). Complete Record of Chan Master Jifei. Jifei Ruyi answers Tanrui's question about today's matter with the noon-sun line.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問：「祖庭創闢萬山巔，七十餘燈續後先，此日爐開烹佛祖，沙盆意旨請師宣。」師云：「日輪正當午。」進云：「一句歸宗萬國朝，虛空合掌森羅拜。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB185.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fushi. Fushi Tongxian answers his questioner's request to declare the meaning of the opened furnace with the noon-sun line.

Occurrences.Kwic: 玄沙云。諦當甚諦當。敢保老兄未徹在。頌云。打破鬼門關。日輪正當午。一箭中紅心。大地無寸土。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1998A.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue. Dahui Zonggao places the noon sun at the center of his verse following Xuansha's comment on Lingyun.

Senses.Explanation: The sun's disk exactly at noon is the corpus's image of the sun at its highest, unobscured position; Chan speakers repeatedly give that image as a direct answer or capping verse rather than as a clock reading. Chaozong and Fushi answer separate requests with the line; Jifei gives it when asked about 'today's matter'; and Dahui sets it between breaking the ghost gate and an arrow striking the center in his verse on Xuansha's comment.
